text:
Type: round nesting side tables
Use: holding drinks, lamps and books; living room, bedroom, reading corner
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern, contemporary
Materials: solid wood frame, black stained and lacquered finish
Colors: black, dark charcoal
Shape: set of two round tops with a raised lip edge, four splayed tapered legs, cross-shaped stretchers, smaller table slides under the larger, slim and light
Feel: graphic, tidy, versatile, calm
Goes with: light wood floors, white walls, grey or cream sofas; Scandinavian or modern living rooms

product.name: KRAGSTA
product.description: The round shape gives you a generous table top for trays, coffee or tea services. And the neat dimensions make the table easy to place in the room.
